issues.issue: The body/cap two-tone is too weak. The shells, niche and console render almost as light as the caps, so the defining JAMCO look (a dark warm taupe-brown body under lighter olive-taupe bullnose caps) reads as one beige-grey mass.
issues.evidence: Shell or console / cap luminance within the same image. Real: f_17313 90/182 = 0.49; omaat_f58 console top 59 / cap 133 = 0.44; omaat_f57 niche 82 / cap 126 = 0.65. Render: q05 shell 142 / cap 169 = 0.84; s3 154/178 = 0.87; s1 161/158 = 1.0. Real hues: shell warm (#604f48, #605956), cap olive with R about G (#807f69, #8a856a). Render fCap #8a8272 is warmer than the cap should be.
issues.fix: In the 09d_suite.js SEATMAT override block (lines 10-20, suite-only materials; fShell/fConsole/fCap are used only by the suite), add fShell: {c:'#594f48'} (about 0.65x the cap) and fConsole: {c:'#625850'}, and move fCap toward olive, '#8a8670'. Re-measure q05 for a shell/cap ratio of about 0.55-0.65.

issues.issue: The bed duvet's new creases read as three glossy rods lying on the duvet, and the fold-back band reads as a separate stiff white board floating on the tapered head edge. Neither reads as soft fabric.
issues.evidence: q04 crop (x 280-830, y 170-460): three straight light sticks with highlit edges, and a lighter slab with hard edges (band L248 vs duvet L224). s5/v2 show the same thing. omaat_f57/f58: soft broad diagonal folds with shadowed valleys, and a turned-down top of the same fabric that blends into the duvet.
issues.fix: Line 280: replace the 0.012-tall gRBox ridges with flush shading strips, e.g. gQuad(dw*0.5, 0.05) at the duvet top +0.001 in '#c9c5bd', or drop them and give the loft at line 276 an off-centre crown instead. Line 278: build the band as a thin gLoft(cushionSecs(dw-0.02, 0.20, 0.025, -0.012, {edge:0.02, r:0.02})) lowered to sit on the duvet top (y about 0.555), in the duvet colour '#dcd8d0' (not the lighter '#ece9e3'), so only its edge shadow shows.

issues.issue: A dashed dark seam still runs down the aft edge of the centre fin between 2D and 2G.
issues.evidence: q02 crop (x 400-520, y 140-360): a broken dark line between two taupe strips for the full height; unchanged from r_head.
issues.fix: Lines 84-85: the two mirrored halves' gRBox edge strips (r 0.004) still meet with rounded edges, which leaves a V-groove. Use gBox (no radius) 0.028 wide centred at x = -hx + 0.002, so each half crosses the centre plane by about 12 mm and the outer faces of the two halves coincide.

issues.issue: The vanity mirror is a square-cornered rectangle, not the rounded pill of the real suite.
issues.evidence: q03 pier crop and q02 2D crop: sharp corners. omaat_f11 and f32: rounded ends, r about 0.04-0.05. The cause is gRBox clamping r to half the 0.012 / 0.004 depth (02_geo.js line 30).
issues.fix: Lines 98-99: build the rim and the glass as gExtrude stadium outlines (an arc of radius mW/2 at each end, the same pattern as the wing at lines 72-75), 0.012 and 0.004 deep, placed with pt(mX, scy, ...).

issues.issue: Residual moire on the fluted leaves at grazing angles.
issues.evidence: s1 forward leaf (x 480-610, y 90-390) and q05: a diamond mesh, fainter than w7.
issues.fix: Line 18: bring fFluteGap closer to fFlute ('#4d4b41'). The slat geometry at line 226 already gives side shading. Alternatively drop LAYER.plastic from fFlute, since the layer texture beating against the 0.026 pitch adds to the pattern.

issues.evidence: s4 crop: thin header, small fillets, a square-topped back. omaat_f9/f57: header about 0.12-0.13, inner fillets about 0.06, a back with rounded top corners.

questions: The real in-flight photos (omaat_f57/f58) show the shells and niche as a warm brown-taupe (#604f48), clearly darker than the olive caps. The official f_17313 shows a cooler darker taupe (#605956). Should the body hue follow the in-flight brown or the official taupe? Either way the value contrast with the caps should be about 0.5-0.65.

Centre pier: with the accepted 1.10 m width, the 2D/2G pier can only be about 0.24 m at 74 deg, so from the aisle it reads at about 40 % of the f32 width. Is that acceptable, or may the centre screen shift slightly toward the board (it already sits 14 mm off) to free a few cm?
